gaps.lead: My laptop needs repairing before the trip.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs to be repaired.

gaps.lead: She'll be at work, so she won't answer the door.
gaps.sentence: She'll be at work, so ___ answer the door.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.lead: We got to the airport late and missed the flight.
gaps.sentence: If we had got to the airport earlier, we ___ the flight.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + participle.

gaps.lead: 'I'll finish the essay by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: He was driving too fast, so he crashed.
gaps.sentence: He wouldn't have crashed if he ___ so fast.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect continuous: hadn't been driving.

gaps.lead: You can borrow the car as long as you drive carefully.
gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ carefully.
gaps.explanation: provided (that) introduces the condition: provided you drive carefully.
